data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fuadah means 'Healer' or 'Restorer'. It is derived from the verb 'fa'ada', which means 'to repair', 'to mend', or 'to heal'. This name holds spiritual significance in Islam, as it is often used to describe the healing power of faith and the capacity of the heart to be restored through spiritual growth. The name Fuadah carries the meaning “Healer, Restorer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fuadah usually hope their child will grow to embody healer, restorer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
